author: Mark Atwood
text:
Fix scope depends on resolution direction:
- Option (a) workspace-wide adopt: 7 Cargo.toml additions + 7 AGENTS.md edits + rewrite of jmap-server BackendSetError/BackendChangesError + chat-server SlowModeError to use thiserror.
- Option (b) calendars-server removes: 1 Cargo.toml + 1 AGENTS.md + 2 hand-roll-Display rewrites in calendars-server/src/backend.rs.
Either direction: /do-beads must verify with `cargo check --workspace` and `cargo test --workspace`.
